MatchedObjectDescriptor.QualificationSummary: Resumes exceeding two pages in length will not be considered, please visit the new resume guidance for more information. Duties - Design, develop, and maintain large-scale Python applications integrating ML and LLM models. - Utilize popular Python modules (e.g., NumPy, Pandas) for data processing and analysis. - Conduct performance analysis to identify memory leaks and ensure scalability in multi-threaded environments. - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and deliver new features. - Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code following Test-Driven Development (TDD) practices. - Use Git or Bitbucket for version control and collaborate using Visual Studio Code. - Integrate with PostgreSQL and MongoDB databases using SQL. - Implement and maintain security best practices, including authentication and authorization. - Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback to team members. - Troubleshoot, debug, and upgrade existing systems. - Resolve production outages and issues by analyzing Splunk logs and Dynatrace. - Apply scaled agile practices and update user stories in Kanban/Sprint boards. READ ALL SECTIONS OF THIS ANNOUNCEMENT IN ITS ENTIRETY. THIS INFORMATION IS CRUCIAL TO SUBMITTING A SUCCESSFUL APPLICATION. Applicants must qualify for the series and grade of the posted position. Experience must be IT related; the experience may be demonstrated by paid or unpaid experience and/or completion of specific, intensive training (for example, IT certification), as appropriate. Your resume must provide sufficient experience and/or education, knowledge, skills, abilities, and proficiency of any required competencies to perform the specific position for which you are applying. To qualify for the 2210 IT Specialist series, the applicant must demonstrate the following competencies: Attention to Detail - Is thorough when performing work and conscientious about attending to detail. Customer Service - Works with clients and customers (that is, any individuals who use or receive the services or products that your work unit produces, including the general public, individuals who work in the agency, other agencies, or organizations outside the Government) to assess their needs, provide information or assistance, resolve their problems, or satisfy their expectations; know about available products and services; and is committed to providing quality products and services. Oral Communication - Expresses information (for example, ideas or facts) to individuals or groups effectively, taking into account the audience and nature of the information (for example, technical, sensitive, controversial); makes clear and convincing oral presentations; listens to others, attends to nonverbal cues, and responds appropriately. Problem Solving - Identifies problems; determines accuracy and relevance of information; uses sound judgment to generate and evaluate alternatives, and to make recommendations. Minimum Qualifications: Grade 14 To qualify at the GS-14 level, you must have specialized experience at the GS-13 level, or equivalent, which is in or related to the work of the position to be filled, that has equipped the applicant with the particular knowledge, skills, and abilities to successfully perform the duties of the position. Such specialized experience must include: Designing, developing, and maintaining large-scale Python applications integrating machine learning (ML) and large language models (LLMs); utilizing popular Python modules (e.g., NumPy, Pandas) for data processing and analysis; conducting performance analysis to identify memory leaks and ensure scalability in multi-threaded environments; collaborating with cross-functional teams to define, design, and deliver new features, and participating in scaled agile practices; writing clean, maintainable, and efficient code following Test-Driven Development (TDD) practice; using Git or Bitbucket for version control and collaborating with team members using Visual Studio Code; integrating PostgreSQL and MongoDB databases using SQL; implementing and maintaining security best practices, including authentication and authorization; participating in code reviews and providing constructive feedback to team members: troubleshooting, debugging, and upgrading existing systems, including resolving production outages and issues by analyzing Splunk logs and Dynatrace; applying scaled agile practices and updating user stories in Kanban/Sprint boards; demonstrating advanced proficiency in developing scalable, multi-threaded Python applications; utilizing Amazon Web Services (AWS) and other cloud platforms (AWS, Azure), including deployment pipelines (Jenkins). Experience to integrating ML and LLM models into production applications. Minimum Qualifications: Grade 15 Applicants for this GS-15 position must have specialized experience at or equivalent to the GS-14 level or above, which is in or related to the work of the position to be filled, that has equipped the applicant with the particular knowledge, skills, and abilities to successfully perform the duties of the position. Such specialized experience must include: Leading the design, development, and maintenance of large-scale Python applications integrating machine learning (ML) and large language models (LLMs); providing expert guidance in utilizing popular Python modules (e.g., NumPy, Pandas) for advanced data processing and analysis; conducting and overseeing performance analysis to identify memory leaks and ensure scalability in multi-threaded environments; collaborating with cross-functional teams to define, design, and deliver new features, and providing technical leadership in scaled agile practices; writing and reviewing clean, maintainable, and efficient code following Test-Driven Development (TDD) practices; managing version control using Git or Bitbucket and facilitating team collaboration with Visual Studio Code; architecting and integrating PostgreSQL and MongoDB databases using advanced SQL techniques: implementing and maintaining security best practices, including authentication and authorization for enterprise applications; leading code reviews and providing constructive feedback to team members; troubleshooting, debugging, and upgrading existing systems, including resolving production outages and issues by analyzing Splunk logs and Dynatrace; applying scaled agile practices and updating user stories in Kanban/Sprint boards; demonstrating advanced proficiency in developing large-scale, scalable, multi-threaded Python applications; architecting solutions using Amazon Web Services (AWS) and other cloud platforms (AWS, Azure), including deployment pipelines (Jenkins); integrating ML and LLM models into production applications and providing strategic direction for their use. PLEASE NOTE: This specialized experience is REQUIRED and must be explicitly documented/described in your resume, or you will be disqualified from further consideration. You may be asked to take a Code Signal online assessment. Qualification standards and additional information for this position can be found here: http://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/classification-qualifications/general-schedule-qualification-standards/2200/information-technology-it-management-series-2210-alternative-a/

Details.OtherInformation: See announcement cutoff dates below under How to Apply. Are you ready to make a real impact at the Social Security Administration? Join our innovative technology team as a Python Developer and help shape the future of digital services for more than 330 million Americans. We're building a team of top-tier developers-those who excel at solving complex challenges and delivering scalable, enterprise-level applications. Details.AgencyMarketingStatement: Apply now for an exciting opportunity at the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC). With an expanded mission and authority to include oversight of the swap markets, the CFTC continues to protect the American public by promoting market integrity, transparency and preventing and prosecuting fraud, manipulation and other abuse in the futures and options markets. Please visit www.cftc.gov to learn more about the CFTC.
MajorDuties: As an Information Technology Specialist (Network) within the Network Operations section, the incumbent collaborates closely with and functions as a technical advisor to the Network Operations Manager in carrying out the agency's responsibilities for implementing a robust and effective enterprise IT program that supports the mission, goals, and objectives of the CFTC. At the full performance level, the duties include: Design, deploy, administer, troubleshoot, and monitor a hybrid network infrastructure including LAN, WAN, SDWAN, VLANs, IPv4/IPv6, MPLS, and data center networks using routers, switches, firewalls, VPNs, and other network technologies. Ensure the rigorous application of information security/information assurance policies, principles, and practices in the delivery of network services. Design, deploy, administer, troubleshoot, and monitor virtual cloud networks (VCN) within the Azure and Aws Government Commercial Cloud (GCC) environments. Collaborate strategically with cross‐functional teams—including IT Operations, Cloud, and Security—to architect, synchronize, and optimize enterprise network capabilities across the agency's integrated physical and virtual infrastructures. This includes driving alignment of hybrid architectures, enforcing security and interoperability standards, and ensuring cohesive end‐to‐end operational performance across all network environments Manage, administer, and troubleshooting M365 technologies including Entra ID, Exchange, Purview, Teams, and OneDrive. Install, test, maintain, and upgrade various network operating systems (Windows/Linux) and software; Supporting other teams on policies, procedures, or technology solutions that have an impact on network infrastructure. Design, engineer, orchestrate, and continuously optimize highly complex virtual cloud network infrastructures (VCN) across AWS and Azure (GCC) environments. This includes architecting and governing Azure VNETs, network security groups, route tables, virtual firewalls, virtual WANs, ExpressRoute/Direct Connect integrations, and the full suite of enterprise-grade virtual network services—ensuring resilient, scalable, secure, and mission‐aligned cloud network architectures.

implementing and overseeing Behavior Driven Development (BDD) practices, including crafting and reviewing test scenarios in Gherkin syntax; directing the development and execution of API tests with Parasoft and Ready API to ensure seamless integration and optimal performance; integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using Git and leading automation platforms, and providing strategic direction for automation initiatives; collaborating with developers, business analysts, and QA teams to ensure comprehensive test coverage and alignment with business and technical requirements; analyzing test results, identifying defects, and leading efforts to resolve issues in coordination with development teams; documenting and reviewing test plans, test cases, and test results to maintain transparency and uphold quality standards; continuously improving test automation frameworks, processes, and best practices to stay ahead of industry trends and emerging technologies; leading code reviews and providing expert feedback on testability and overall software quality; staying current with emerging technologies and trends in test automation and quality assurance, and guiding the organization in adopting new tools and methodologies; demonstrating hands-on experience in automated software testing, with a focus on BDD and proficiency in Selenium, Gherkin, and Cucumber; managing API testing using Parasoft and Ready API, and integrating with CI/CD tools and processes (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, AWS DevOps); applying expert knowledge of the software development life cycle (SDLC), Agile methodologies, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud); leading performance and load testing initiatives using tools such as JMeter and LoadRunner; providing advanced analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, and demonstrating strong written and verbal communication abilities. PLEASE NOTE: This specialized experience is REQUIRED and must be explicitly documented/described in your resume, or you will be disqualified from further consideration. With an expanded mission and authority to include oversight of the swap markets, the CFTC continues to protect the American public by promoting market integrity, transparency and preventing and prosecuting fraud, manipulation and other abuse in the futures and options markets. Please visit www.cftc.gov to learn more about the CFTC.
MajorDuties: The Market and Financial Systems (MFS) group within the Data Operations and Standards Branch of the Division of Data is responsible for managing more than 25 custom and COTS mission facing applications, supporting users from the mission divisions around the Commission doing market surveillance, risk and financial surveillance, review and approval, and public reporting. As an IT Project Manager, the incumbent: The incumbent manages project tasks including all activities associated with project management: project planning, progress assessments, quality reviews, implementation strategies, regular user communication, regular staff communication, risk management, and benefits analysis. The incumbent supervises all contract activities including serving as the technical representative for the contract, managing the financial aspects of the contract, managing the quality of the contracted work, managing contract scope, managing contract personnel issues, and ensuring quality and timely receipt of project/program deliverables. The incumbent acquires and maintains knowledge of the CFTC business, specifically focusing on market and trade surveillance of the futures, options, and swaps markets as well as newer markets such as event-based contracts and cryptocurrency. The incumbent acquires knowledge of the CFTC mission to translate mission needs into a technical solution. This duty also includes the development of a depth of knowledge that will allow for recognition of the relationships of business interests and technical solutions. The incumbent provides technical leadership of the program. This duty includes providing and managing the technical vision and direction for market surveillance solutions as well as any other solutions the commission requires to meet the changing market surveillance environment. The incumbent provides technical guidance for the implementation of new software applications to meet the changing needs of CFTC staff by assessing the ability of software technologies to support mission goals. The incumbent communicates with the project team, CFTC management, and project/program stakeholders on the overall status of the program. The incumbent identifies project risk, establishes goals, assesses product quality, and implementation timeliness. The incumbent is proactive and regularly communicates on project activities. The incumbent conducts project-oriented resource analysis and makes resource recommendations to leadership. The incumbent determines the resources needed to successfully execute each effort within the program. The incumbent prepares cost benefit justification for any recommendation. The incumbent advises DOD leadership regarding the status of issues within the project that may potentially impact DOD Strategies and Policies.
Details.Requirements: You will be evaluated on the basis of your level of competency (knowledge, skills and abilities) in the following areas: 1. Knowledge of Project and Program Management Knowledge of project management principles, methodologies, and practices sufficient to plan, execute, monitor, and evaluate complex information technology projects and programs, including risk management, quality assurance, resource management, and implementation planning. 2. Knowledge of Contract Management and Oversight Knowledge of federal contracting principles and contractor oversight practices sufficient to serve as a Contracting Officer's Representative (COR) or technical representative, monitor contractor performance, manage project deliverables, and ensure compliance with contract requirements. 3. Knowledge of Financial Markets and Regulatory Operations Knowledge of market surveillance, trade surveillance, and regulatory operations involving futures, options, swaps, digital assets, cryptocurrency, and emerging financial products sufficient to support the agency's mission and business objectives. 4. Skill in Business Analysis and Technical Solution Development Skill in analyzing complex business requirements and translating mission needs into effective technical solutions, including identifying system requirements, evaluating alternatives, and aligning technology investments with organizational goals. 5. Ability to Communicate and Collaborate with Diverse Stakeholders Ability to communicate effectively with executives, technical staff, contractors, and program stakeholders to provide project status updates, facilitate decision-making, resolve issues, manage expectations, and build consensus on project objectives and outcomes.

Details.JobSummary: This position is located in the Small Business Administration, Office of the Chief Information Officer in Washington, DC. The Director of Cloud and Infrastructure Management is located within the Office of the Chief Information Officer (OCIO) and serves as the principal authority for enterprise cloud strategy, hybrid infrastructure modernization, and technology platform services across the Small Business Administration.
Details.SubAgencyName: Office of the Chief Information Officer
Details.AgencyMarketingStatement: The U.S. Small Business Administration helps power the American dream of entrepreneurship. As the federal government's leading advocate for small businesses, we empower job creators with the essential resources and support they need to start, grow, and expand their businesses or recover from a declared disaster. Our services reach communities nationwide through a robust network of SBA field offices and partnerships with both public and private organizations. If you're seeking more than just a job - if you desire purpose, impact, and the chance to contribute to something truly meaningful - this is your opportunity. Small businesses are our nation's backbone, driving innovation, creating jobs, and fueling prosperity. At the SBA, you'll directly help empower these vital businesses and ignite economic growth under the leadership of President Donald J. Trump and Administrator Kelly Loeffler. For over 70 years, the SBA has fueled America's small business success by providing crucial access to capital, federal contracts, and expert guidance. Beyond our critical disaster recovery efforts, where we deploy aid and expertise to help communities rebuild, your role will directly contribute to the start, growth, and expansion of businesses nationwide, creating jobs and strengthening the economic fabric of our communities.
MajorDuties: As a/an Supervisory IT Specialist (Director of Cloud and Infrastructure Management) at theGS- 2210-15, some of your typical work assignments may include: Leads and develops government IT specialists and oversees contractors performing cloud and infrastructure work, planning and assigning work, evaluating performance, and recommending personnel actions. Develops and executes enterprise cloud and infrastructure strategy and multi-year roadmaps across hybrid cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), including budget formulation and FinOps cost optimization. Ensures cloud and infrastructure meet enterprise architecture and federal cybersecurity frameworks (Zero Trust, FISMA, NIST), reducing vulnerabilities through DevSecOps and infrastructure-as-code. Translates mission needs into technical requirements, defines and monitors service level agreements, and represents cloud services to executives, cloud providers, and interagency partners.

MatchedObjectDescriptor.QualificationSummary: GS-15: One year of specialized experience, equivalent to the GS-14 grade level in the Federal service, obtained in either the private or public sector: Supervising or leading technical staff or contractors performing cloud, infrastructure, or platform work, including assigning work and evaluating performance; and Developing or executing cloud or infrastructure strategy, technology roadmaps, or budgets for a large organization; and Ensuring cloud or infrastructure environments meet security and compliance requirements, including vulnerability remediation or automation; and Working with senior leaders, customers, or vendors to define requirements, service levels, or technology investment decisions. These qualifications must be clearly referenced in your resume. If you are a current career or career-conditional federal employee applying for promotion under Merit Promotion you must have completed a minimum of 52 weeks in positions at the next level lower than the position being filled. Additional information on the qualification requirements is outlined in the OPM Qualifications Standards Handbook of General Schedule Positions. It is available for your review on OPM's Qualifications web site: Competency-Based Qualification Standard for the Information Technology Management Series, 2210 Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g. Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community, student, social). Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience. Generally, time in Non-Pay status as a federal employee is not creditable towards the specialized experience requirement listed above. All qualification requirements must be met by 11:59 pm (Eastern Time) on 12/01/2026.

Details.JobSummary: This position is located in the Small Business Administration, Office of the Chief Information Officer in Washington, DC. The Director of Cloud and Infrastructure Management is located within the Office of the Chief Information Officer (OCIO) and serves as the principal authority for enterprise cloud strategy, hybridinfrastructure modernization, and technology platform services across the Small Business Administration.
Details.SubAgencyName: Office of the Chief Information Officer
Details.AgencyMarketingStatement: The U.S. Small Business Administration helps power the American dream of entrepreneurship. As the federal government's leading advocate for small businesses, we empower job creators with the essential resources and support they need to start, grow, and expand their businesses or recover from a declared disaster. Our services reach communities nationwide through a robust network of SBA field offices and partnerships with both public and private organizations. If you're seeking more than just a job - if you desire purpose, impact, and the chance to contribute to something truly meaningful - this is your opportunity. Small businesses are our nation's backbone, driving innovation, creating jobs, and fueling prosperity. At the SBA, you'll directly help empower these vital businesses and ignite economic growth under the leadership of President Donald J. Trump and Administrator Kelly Loeffler. For over 70 years, the SBA has fueled America's small business success by providing crucial access to capital, federal contracts, and expert guidance. Beyond our critical disaster recovery efforts, where we deploy aid and expertise to help communities rebuild, your role will directly contribute to the start, growth, and expansion of businesses nationwide, creating jobs and strengthening the economic fabric of our communities.
MajorDuties: As a/an Supervisory IT Specialist (Director of Cloud and Infrastructure Management) at theGS- 2210-15, some of your typical work assignments may include: Leads and develops government IT specialists and oversees contractors performing cloud and infrastructure work, planning and assigning work, evaluating performance, and recommending personnel actions. Develops and executes enterprise cloud and infrastructure strategy and multi-year roadmaps across hybrid cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), including budget formulation and FinOps cost optimization. Ensures cloud and infrastructure meet enterprise architecture and federal cybersecurity frameworks (Zero Trust, FISMA, NIST), reducing vulnerabilities through DevSecOps and infrastructure-as-code. Translates mission needs into technical requirements, defines and monitors service level agreements, and represents cloud services to executives, cloud providers, and interagency partners.

MatchedObjectDescriptor.QualificationSummary: BASIC QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS: To be considered for this position, you must have either: 1. Degree: Mathematics, statistics, computer science, data science or field directly related to the position. The degree must be in a major field of study (at least at the baccalaureate level) that is appropriate for the position. OR 2. Combination of education and experience: Courses equivalent to a major field of study (30 semester hours) as shown in paragraph A above, plus additional education or appropriate experience. In addition to meeting the specialized experience below you must meet the basic requirement above to qualify for this position. CT-15 Level: To qualify for the CT-15 level you must have at least one year of specialized experience equivalent to the next lower grade (GS/CT-14 level). Specialized experience is defined that through which one has gained experience: Experience in applying comprehensive knowledge of derivatives and futures market structure, trading operations, and emerging financial instruments, including perpetual futures contracts, event contracts, and 24×7 markets with fractional order quantities, to inform enterprise data architecture design and strategy. AND Experience in designing, developing, and implementing large-scale enterprise data architectures within hybrid cloud environments, including Microsoft SQL Server on Microsoft Azure for transactional processing and AWS platforms such as Amazon Redshift, Amazon SageMaker, and ClickHouse for analytical data solutions. AND Experience in leading and managing teams of technical professionals, including assigning and prioritizing work, evaluating employee performance, providing coaching and mentoring, and developing staff within data engineering and data architecture organizations. AND Experience in applying data governance principles, data modeling standards, metadata management practices, and data quality frameworks to support regulatory, financial, or similarly complex enterprise data environments. AND Experience in monitoring emerging developments in financial markets and technology, assessing their impact on enterprise data architecture strategies, and advising senior leadership on risks, opportunities, and recommended courses of action.

Details.JobSummary: The Division of Data (DOD) is directed by the Division Director and serves as the leading authority on the CFTC's enterprise data. The Division provides CTFC-wide leadership on data governance, engineering, architecture, collection, standards, training, and enterprise analytics and AI product development. This position is located in the Division of Data (DOD) and reports directly to the Deputy Director of Director of the Division.
Details.AgencyMarketingStatement: Apply now for an exciting opportunity at the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC). With an expanded mission and authority to include oversight of the swap markets, the CFTC continues to protect the American public by promoting market integrity, transparency and preventing and prosecuting fraud, manipulation and other abuse in the futures and options markets. Please visit www.cftc.gov to learn more about the CFTC.
MajorDuties: Serves as the authoritative technical expert and senior Data Scientist for the CFTC's next generation of data science tools. The incumbent analyzes, designs, develops, and maintains tools used by mission staff. Provides expert-level market understanding and data science leadership across the CFTC's data environment. provides expert-level market understanding and data science leadership across the CFTC's data environment. Develops and delivers compelling presentations, briefings, documentation, and demonstrations tailored to a wide range of audiences — from technical engineers to senior agency leadership — to build organizational understanding, buy-in, and adoption of new data science tools and techniques. Translates complex, often ambiguous user needs into clear, actionable architectural specifications and ensures that the resulting data environment supports analysis, decision-making, external reporting, and regulatory oversight activities. Plans, organizes, directs, and supervises the work of a team of Data Scientists. The incumbent assigns work based on priorities, difficulty, and the capabilities of employees; evaluates performance; provides feedback, coaching, and development opportunities; and takes or recommends appropriate personnel actions.

Please ensure your resume clearly demonstrates how you meet the qualifications for the position within the two-page limit. Content of Resume: Your resume or other written form you choose to describe your job-related experiences are used to verify your qualifications. Therefore, it is important that your resume accurately reflects the duties and responsibilities under each position you have held with each employer. In describing your experience, please be clear and specific. It is your responsibility to make sure your resume states complete information for each job entry (beginning and ending dates of employment stated as MM/YYYY to MM/YYYY; and total number of hours worked per week). If your resume does not provide enough information regarding your work history for us to make a creditable qualification determination, your application package may be rendered disqualified, and you will no longer be considered for this position. To assist you in sending in a complete resume, use the checklist at: https://www.usajobs.gov/Help/faq/application/documents/resume/what-to-include Please follow the instructions listed below for submitting your complete application package. Application procedures are specific to this vacancy announcement. Please read all instructions before you begin. Resume Requirements: Resumes are limited to two (2) pages. Resumes should focus on the knowledge, skills, abilities; accomplishments and results; and training and education relevant to this position. Resumes must be in the following format (for each position held relevant to this position): Short summary of position duties Accomplishments while in the position Results of those accomplishments Copying and pasting position descriptions into a resume is not acceptable. Illegible Information and/or Documents If your supporting documents and resume are illegible or do not provide the necessary information for the Human Capital Specialist and/or Subject Matter Expert to make a qualification determination, you may lose consideration for this position. Last Document Uploaded If multiple copies of the same document are uploaded/faxed and submitted with your application, CFTC will only consider the last copy of the document uploaded/faxed when determining your eligibility and qualifications. For example, if you upload/fax two or more resumes only the last resume uploaded/faxed and submitted will be considered. You must complete and submit an application by accessing the USAJOBS website at USAJOBS.GOV. To begin, click the Apply Online button within the vacancy announcement and follow the prompts to create an account using LOGIN.GOV, if you have not done so already. MatchedObjectDescriptor.QualificationSummary: Resumes exceeding two pages in length will not be considered, please visit the new resume guidance for more information. READ ALL SECTIONS OF THIS ANNOUNCEMENT IN ITS ENTIRETY. THIS INFORMATION IS CRUCIAL TO SUBMITTING A SUCCESSFUL APPLICATION. Applicants must qualify for the series and grade of the posted position. Experience must be IT related; the experience may be demonstrated by paid or unpaid experience and/or completion of specific, intensive training (for example, IT certification), as appropriate. Your resume must provide sufficient experience and/or education, knowledge, skills, abilities, and proficiency of any required competencies to perform the specific position for which you are applying. To qualify for the 2210 IT Specialist series, the applicant must demonstrate the following competencies: Attention to Detail - Is thorough when performing work and conscientious about attending to detail. Customer Service - Works with clients and customers (that is, any individuals who use or receive the services or products that your work unit produces, including the general public, individuals who work in the agency, other agencies, or organizations outside the Government) to assess their needs, provide information or assistance, resolve their problems, or satisfy their expectations; know about available products and services; and is committed to providing quality products and services. Oral Communication - Expresses information (for example, ideas or facts) to individuals or groups effectively, taking into account the audience and nature of the information (for example, technical, sensitive, controversial); makes clear and convincing oral presentations; listens to others, attends to nonverbal cues, and responds appropriately. Problem Solving - Identifies problems; determines accuracy and relevance of information; uses sound judgment to generate and evaluate alternatives, and to make recommendations. Minimum Qualifications: Grade 13 (Bargaining Unit Position): Applicants for this GS-13 position must have specialized experience at or equivalent to the GS-12 level or above, which is in or related to the work of the position to be filled, that has equipped the applicant with the particular knowledge, skill and abilities to successfully perform the duties of the position. Such IT-related experience must include: Developing service-oriented web applications and APIs in an agile environment using frameworks such as Angular or Spring Boot Coordinating development efforts to ensure project completion and implementation OR leading technical discussions for enterprise-level IT projects Developing object-oriented software that interfaces with Relational databases and leverages Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery technology to comply with modern development standards. Minimum Qualifications: Grade 14: Applicants for this GS-14 position must have specialized experience at or equivalent to the GS-13 level or above, which is in or related to the work of the position to be filled, that has equipped the applicant with the particular knowledge, skill and abilities to successfully perform the duties of the position. Such IT-related experience must include: Advanced proficiency developing service-oriented web applications and APIs in an agile environment using Frameworks such as Angular or Spring Boot, languages such as Java, Node.js, APIs such as RESTful/SOAP and Platforms such as AWS/PaaS Advanced proficiency developing object-oriented software that interfaces with database technologies such as DB2, SQL, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and leverages Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery technology to comply with modern development standards. Advanced experience leading and coordinating development efforts to ensure project completion and implementation OR leading technical discussions for enterprise-level IT projects; and Hands-on experience with collaborative development tools such as Git, Bitbucket, and Visual Studio. Minimum Qualifications: Grade 15: Applicants for this GS-15 position must have specialized experience at or equivalent to the GS-14 level or above, which is in or related to the work of the position to be filled, that has equipped the applicant with the particular knowledge, skill and abilities to successfully perform the duties of the position. Such IT-related experience must include: Expertly developing service-oriented web applications and APIs in an agile environment using advanced frameworks such as Angular and Spring Boot, programming languages including Java and Node.js, and platforms like AWS/PaaS. Advanced proficiency in designing and implementing object-oriented software solutions interfacing with databases such as DB2, SQL, MongoDB, and PostgreSQL, and leveraging CI/CD technologies to meet modern development standards. Leading and coordinating complex development efforts for enterprise-level IT projects at an expert level, including facilitating technical discussions and ensuring successful project completion and implementation. Collaborating with cross-functional teams to define, design, and deliver new features; participated in code reviews; and communicated complex technical concepts to executives and team members in clear, accessible terms, consistently demonstrating advanced expertise. Integrating COTS solutions into robust, API-driven architectures for real-time system connectivity; expertly resolved production issues using appropriate tools; applied advanced scaled agile practices and real-time data processing skills. PLEASE NOTE: This specialized experience is REQUIRED and must be explicitly documented/described in your resume, or you will be disqualified from further consideration You may be asked to take a Code Signal online assessment. Qualification standards and additional information for this position can be found here: http://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/classification-qualifications/general-schedule-qualification-standards/2200/information-technology-it-management-series-2210-alternative-a/

Details.JobSummary: IT Specialist (APPSW), JAVA Angular Full Stack Web Application Developer positions are being filled through the Office of Personnel Management's delegated Direct Hire Authority, open to all U.S. citizens. Under the provisions of the Direct Hire Authority, Veterans Preference and the "Rule of Many" do not apply.
Details.AgencyMarketingStatement: Are you ready to make a real impact at the Social Security Administration? Join our forward-thinking technology team as a Java/Angular Full Stack Web Application Developer and help shape the future of digital services for more than 330 million Americans. We're building a team of top-tier developers-those who excel at solving complex challenges and delivering scalable, enterprise-level web applications. Whether you're a seasoned expert ready to drive innovation or an early-career developer eager to learn from the best, we want you to be part of our mission to deliver cutting-edge technology and exceptional service. We value developers who are passionate about creating seamless user experiences and robust backend solutions. If you thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and are excited to work with the latest technologies, this is the place for you. We are especially interested in developers who understand how Artificial Intelligence (AI) can be leveraged to revamp and optimize existing processes, making our systems more efficient and effective for both customers and employees. If you're ready to take your career to the next level-whether you're a proven leader or an ambitious learner-apply today and help us build the future of digital government services! Recruitment incentive may be authorized. Outstationing may be available at the GS15 level.
MajorDuties: This announcement serves as public notice. Applications submitted be placed into a pool and will remain on file for selection as positions become available.

Vacancies may be filled for up to 6 months after the closing date of this announcement. Applicants may not receive notifications of referral status until the full 6-month eligibility period has elapsed.
Positions filled with applications from this pool will be placed into positions where artificial intelligence duties occupy the majority of the work performed.
Details.Evaluations: The evaluation you receive is based on your responses to the online assessment questions completed during the application process. Please make sure you answer all questions and follow all instructions carefully. Errors or omissions may affect your evaluation. Information not specifically stated in your resume cannot be assumed. Information that is copied or restated language from the vacancy announcement or rating criteria will not be considered. If this occurs, you may be found ineligible. You may be asked to take an online technical assessment test as part of the application process. The technical assessment will come from a third party called CodeSignal, a widely used coding assessment platform that has been adopted and validated by the Office of Personnel Management (OPM) for federal IT hiring. This assessment is a live coding exercise completed in a proctored online environment. The assessment is designed to evaluate practical programming skills relevant to the position. If you receive an email to take the CodeSignal assessment, this assessment is one component of our evaluation process, not the sole determining factor. Your application, resume, and other qualifications remain an important part of our review

Details.AgencyMarketingStatement: DHS is calling on those who want to help protect American interests and secure our Nation. DHS Components work collectively to prevent terrorism; secure borders and our transportation systems; protect the President and other dignitaries; enforce and administer immigration laws; safeguard cyberspace; and ensure resilience to disasters. The DHS Joint Duty Program (JDP) is an intra- and inter-departmental program which offers civilian personnel professional and developmental opportunities. Joint Duty Assignments (JDAs) enhance operations and mission execution through unity of effort and collaboration. The DHS JDP is a human capital program initiative which is managed by OCHCO at DHS headquarters. The DHS JDP's purpose is two-fold: to encourage and to facilitate assignments of DHS personnel to other DHS components as well as outside agencies. The purpose of JDAs is to gain multi-component, multi-faceted experience focused on cross-cutting DHS and Federal-wide operations to enhance performance of the individual, the organizations, and the Department. JDAs are for a period not to exceed 1 year and do not qualify for Joint Duty credit. The DHS JDP covers current Federal employees at the GS-12 through GS-15 grade levels and equivalent. The DHS JDP does not apply to members of the military service or contractors. JDAs do not offer Temporary Promotions.
MajorDuties: Provides senior technical leadership for enterprise ICAM programs, including identity governance, privileged access management, authentication, federation, and Zero Trust initiatives. Collaborates across organizations to develop strategy, modernize identity services, implement secure access solutions, and advance cybersecurity capabilities supporting mission and enterprise objectives.

DLA provides worldwide logistics support for the missions of the Military Departments and the Unified Combatant Commands under conditions of peace and war. It also provides logistics support to other DoD Components and certain Federal agencies, foreign governments, international organizations, and others as authorized.
MajorDuties: Provides complex management advisory and technical services on the most important and substantive IT applications software functions and modern practices to DoD managers and subject-matter experts.

Identifies and proposes solutions to the most significant, complex, and difficult DoD IT applications software and system interface issues, with a focus on enterprise SAP environments, API integrations, and cross-platform interoperability.

Monitors software development projects to ensure compliance with specifications; plans and coordinates the testing, installation, and implementation of software, including SAP S/4HANA solutions, middleware platforms, and API lifecycle management.

Provides oversight and technical direction for SAP system architecture, integration frameworks (e.g., SAP Pl/PO, SAP CPI, SAP BTP Integration Suite), and data exchange mechanisms supporting mission-critical logistics and financial systems.

Develops IT program policies, procedures, and practices, ensuring the agency is responsible, accountable, and in compliance with overarching directives and guidance, includes DoD cybersecurity, Zero Trust architecture, data governance requirements.

Provides technical expertise and guidance supporting decisions regarding assigned programs and devises methodologies, techniques, and synchronized approaches to identify and propose solutions to unprecedented...
...difficult management or programmatic problems involving enterprise resource planning (ERP) and API ecosystems.
Leads cross-functional integration efforts across SAP modules (e.g., Fl/CO, MM, SD, WM) and external systems, ensuring seamless data flow and system interoperability.

Provides visionary technical leadership and guidance to cross-functional teams, fostering a collaborative and high-performing work environment, and mentoring junior engineers and developers in SAP and API best practices.
Establishes and enforces API governance standards, integration patterns, and DevSecOps practices, including Cl/CD pipelines, version control, and automated testing frameworks.

Report status of programs to leadership, including current activities, risks, issues, and opportunities impacting software systems, with emphasis on integration risks, system dependencies, and enterprise architecture alignment.

Drug-Free Workplace Policy The Defense Logistics Agency (DLA) is committed to maintaining a safe, drug-free workplace. All DLA employees are required to refrain from illegal drug use on and off duty. DLA conducts pre-employment, reasonable suspicion, post-accident, and random drug testing. Applicants tentatively selected for employment in testing designated positions will undergo a urinalysis to screen for illegal drug use prior to appointment. Refusal to undergo testing or testing positive for illegal drugs will result in withdrawal of the tentative job offer and a six-month denial of employment with DLA from the date of the drug test. Employees in drug testing designated positions are subject to random drug testing. A negative drug test result must be received by HR within 30 calendar days after the EOD (i.e., start date). The selectee's inability successfully pass; or refusal to conduct the test may result in: 1) the tentative or FJO being withdrawn during the recruitment process; or 2) subsequently being removed from Federal service for failure to meet a condition of employment. You may be required to sign a "Drug Test Statement of Understanding" if you are selected for this position. The DLA drug testing panel tests for the following substances: marijuana, cocaine, opiates, heroin, phencyclidine, amphetamines, methamphetamines, fentanyl, norfentanyl, methylenedioxymethamphetamine (MDMA), methylenedioxyamphetamine (MDA), and opioids. ADVISORY: Use of cannabidiol (CBD) products may result in a positive drug test for marijuana. DLA employees are subject to Federal law and under Federal law, Marijuana is illegal. MajorDuties: The following are the duties of this position at the full working level. If this vacancy includes more than one grade and you are selected at a lower grade level, you will have the opportunity to learn to perform these duties and receive training to help you grow in this position. Develops and implements new cloud concepts, security architectures, methodologies, standards, and operational procedures in IT security across cloud service providers (Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP)). Provides expert guidance to other IT professionals throughout the IRS, Treasury, and in other agencies regarding cloud modernization initiatives, enterprise security integration, and emerging technologies, to develop the overall program area and to identify mission related work and/or how it may impact other IT initiatives. Oversees and manages the identification, evaluation, and reporting of information security, data protection, insider threat, and enterprise risk management issues to ensure compliance with federal laws, regulatory requirements, executive orders, and government-wide cybersecurity standards while aligning with and supporting the overall enterprise risk posture. Reviews, evaluates, and analyzes IRS cloud security policies, standards, and procedures to ensure they are up-to-date, comply with applicable federal mandates, cybersecurity frameworks, regulations, agency strategic objectives, and other binding standards. Ensures policies remain current and effectively address evolving threats, operational risks, and user impacts. Serves as the expert technical advisor on agency-wide information security, and privacy programs and initiatives to comply with federally mandated security requirements, Zero Trust Architecture principles, and commonly accepted industry security best practices while advising on integrating IT programs with other business programs of equivalent complexity within the IRS.
Details.Education: QUALIFICATIONS CONTINUED SPECIALIZED EXPERIENCE GS-15: You must have one year of specialized experience at a level of difficulty and responsibility equivalent to the GS-14 grade level in Federal service. Specialized experience for this position includes: Directing, overseeing, or providing strategic guidance for major IT programs, enterprise-level projects, technology modernization efforts, or high-visibility initiatives with broad organizational, agency-wide, or mission impact. Applying IT principles, to evaluate requirements, resolve complex technical issues, guide architecture and design decisions, and ensure compliance with cybersecurity, privacy, accessibility, and federal requirements.. Collaborating with executives, senior leaders, customers, stakeholders, program or product leaders, and technical organizations to define mission needs, set priorities, and direct implementation of secure, resilient, scalable, and mission-effective IT solutions. Overseeing enterprise technology governance, risk management, modernization planning, and implementation efforts across multiple organizations. Evaluating competing technical, operational, software, and strategic approaches and advising senior leadership or executive stakeholders on decisions, tradeoffs, policies, standards, governance, and resolution of IT challenges that affect mission delivery. And ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE EXPERIENCE Experience that includes one or more of the following: Leading enterprise AI strategies or directing the design, development, integration, or implementation of Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Generative AI, Natural Language Processing, or related technologies. Establishing enterprise AI architectures, governance, technical standards, security requirements, or modernization strategies. Advising executive leadership regarding AI strategy, responsible AI implementation, enterprise data architecture, vendor capabilities, or AI-enabled modernization initiatives. Or CYBERSECURITY EXPERIENCE Experience that includes one or more of the following: Providing executive-level technical leadership for enterprise cybersecurity, cloud security, Zero Trust, identity management, enterprise risk management, or infrastructure protection initiatives. Developing enterprise cybersecurity architectures, modernization strategies, technical standards, or risk management frameworks. Advising executive leadership regarding enterprise cybersecurity strategy, emerging threats, modernization priorities, technology investments, or government-wide cybersecurity initiatives. You must also meet the following requirements MINIMUM AGE REQUIREMENT: Minimum age for federal employment is 18 years old, or at least 16 years old and have: Graduated from high school or been awarded a certificate equivalent to graduating from high school; or Completed a formal vocational training program; or Received a statement from school authorities agreeing with your preference for employment rather than continuing your education. MatchedObjectDescriptor.QualificationSummary: MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS To qualify at the CL 28 level, the applicant must have two years specialized experience, including at least one year equivalent to work at the next level (CL 27). Specialized experience is progressively responsible experience that provides the candidate with the knowledge and skills necessary to successfully perform the duties of this position. For this role, applicants must have a minimum of two years of specialized experience demonstrating the ability to work with applications across all phases of the ITIL application lifecycle. A master's degree, or two years of graduate study, may be substituted for the required specialized experience if obtained in a field directly related to the subject matter of this position. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Preference will be given to candidates with progressive technical experience developing and supporting web-based applications using Microsoft Visual Studio/ASP.NET, C#, SharePoint, SQL, JavaScript (React, Angular) and HTML. Experience with server operating systems and database products - including Red Hat Enterprise Linux, Windows Server (2019 and above), Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL, and Informix Dynamic Server - is preferred. Experience with Server Studio and Microsoft IIS is desirable, as is familiarity with off-the-shelf reporting tools such as Crystal Reports, Business Objects, and RePortal. Working knowledge of the Microsoft ecosystem, including Power Platform and related robotic process automation (RPA) tools, is highly desired. Preference will also be given to candidates who demonstrate: Strong customer service skills. The ability to work collaboratively with clients, team members, and managers. The ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. The ability to see assigned projects through to completion. A bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university is also preferred.

Details.JobSummary: The Applications Administrator covers a broad application portfolio: locally developed custom software, national judiciary applications (CM/ECF, JMS, PACTS, etc.), applications developed by other federal courts, and commercially available software solutions. Core responsibilities include database and application maintenance, security vulnerability mitigation, customer issue resolution, development and implementation of custom web-based applications, and custom report development.
Details.SubAgencyName: U. S. District Court, District of Arizona
Details.AgencyMarketingStatement: The U.S. District Court for the District of Arizona is seeking two Applications Administrators to join its consolidated Information Technology support division. This position reports to the Systems Technology Division Manager and supports mission-critical applications for the Clerk's Office (including chambers staff) and the U.S. Probation and Pretrial Services Office throughout the District.
MajorDuties: The Systems Technology Division delivers technical support to all court units - the Clerk's Office (including judges and chambers staff) and the U.S. Probation and Pretrial Services Office - across four locations in the District of Arizona. The division supports approximately 600 employees and oversees multiple data centers, telecommunications and networking infrastructure, and a large fleet of end-user devices (iPads, iPhones, and Windows laptops), in addition to an application catalog spanning locally developed software, off-the-shelf products, and nationally supported systems. The Application Administrator is responsible for the operation, maintenance, and enhancement of software applications supporting the District of Arizona's mission, including locally developed custom software, national applications (CM/ECF, JMS, PACTS), applications developed by other federal courts, and commercial software solutions. Key areas of knowledge and skills include: Microsoft Products: SharePoint, Power Platform, Microsoft IIS, Azure & AWS Databases: Mircosoft SQL, IBM Informix, & My SQL Programming Languages: C#, JavaScript (React, Angular), Python & .Net Reporting Tools: Crystal Reports, Power BI, Business Objects & Reportal Additional Areas: API, AI/LLM (Claude, Open AI, Gem) & Docker Containers Regular administrative responsibilities include routine database and application maintenance, security vulnerability mitigation, customer issue resolution, development and implementation of custom web-based applications, development and maintenance of interfaces between locally developed and nationally supported judiciary applications, and custom report development. The Application Administrator may also perform Windows Server and Linux system administration duties. The successful candidate must have a keen eye for detail and a strong customer service orientation. Additional representative duties include: Developing and supporting APIs to enable integration between internal and external systems. Developing and integrating various large language models (LLMs) into court applications and workflows. Performing full-stack development, including front-end UI/UX design and back-end system logic. Building, deploying, and maintaining applications using Docker containers.

Details.OtherInformation: This job is being filled by an alternative hiring process and is not in the competitive civil service. The initial appointment to this position is provisional pending the successful completion of the required background checks and/or investigations. Only qualified applicants will be considered for this position. Employees of the U.S. District Court serve under "Excepted Appointments" and are considered "at will" employees (except for probation officers who may be removed for cause). Federal Civil Service classifications or regulations do not apply; however, court employees are entitled to substantially the same benefits as other Federal Government employees. The U.S. District Court is a drug-free workplace and the applicant selected will be required to participate in a drug screening test prior to employment. All information provided by applicants is subject to verification and background investigation. Applicants are advised that false statements or omission of information on any application materials or the inability to meet the following conditions may be grounds for non-selection, withdrawal of an offer of employment or dismissal after being employed. Participation in the interview process will be at the applicant's own expense and relocation expenses will not be provided. All promotions are subject to the approval of the Administrative Office of the U.S. Courts. The position is subject to the mandatory electronic fund transfer (EFT) participation for payment of net pay (i.e. Direct Deposit). Non-citizens may be interviewed and considered for employment, but employment offers will only be made to individuals who qualify under one of the exceptions in 8 U.S.C. §1324b(a)(3)(B). In most cases, this means that an offer of employment cannot be made unless the candidate is a lawful permanent resident who is seeking U.S. citizenship as explained below. Under 8 U.S.C. §1324b(a)(3)(B), a lawful permanent resident seeking citizenship may not apply for citizenship until he or she has been a permanent resident for at least five years (three years if seeking naturalization as a spouse of a citizen), at which point he or she must apply for citizenship within six months of becoming eligible, and must complete the process within two years of applying (unless there is a delay caused by the processors of the application). Non-citizens who have not been permanent residents for five years will be required to execute an affidavit that they intend to apply for citizenship when they become eligible to do so. The U.S. Probation and Pretrial Services Office, District of Arizona is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

MatchedObjectDescriptor.QualificationSummary: BASIC QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS: To be considered for this position, you must have either: 1. Specialized experience is defined that through which one has gained experience: Experience understanding of derivatives and futures market structure, instruments, and trading operations, including emerging and novel instruments such as perpetual futures contracts, event contracts, and markets with 24×7 continuous trading and fractional order quantities, and the implications of these for conducting analysis. Details.JobSummary: The Division of Data (DOD) is directed by the Division Director and serves as the leading authority on the CFTC's enterprise data. The Division provides CFTC-wide leadership on data governance, engineering, architecture, collection, standards, training, and enterprise analytics and AI product development.
Details.AgencyMarketingStatement: Apply now for an exciting opportunity at the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC). With an expanded mission and authority to include oversight of the swap markets, the CFTC continues to protect the American public by promoting market integrity, transparency and preventing and prosecuting fraud, manipulation and other abuse in the futures and options markets. Please visit www.cftc.gov to learn more about the CFTC.
MajorDuties: This position is located in the Division of Data (DOD) and reports directly to the Deputy Director or Director of the Division. The Senior Data Scientist (Data Architect) serves as the principal data scientist responsible for applying mathematical, statistical, and computer science methods to design, build, and manage the large-scale data framework at the CFTC. The Data Scientist then evangelizes the next generation of CFTC's market data architecture to meet those needs. The incumbent provides the highest level of technical and strategic leadership in representing the increasingly complex derivatives and futures markets within the CFTC's data environment, ensuring that the Commission's data infrastructure is capable of accurately capturing, storing, and serving data across all regulated markets — including rapidly evolving instruments and trading paradigms. The incumbent selects the appropriate mathematical, statistical, and computer science methods to then analyze, design, build, and maintain the CFTC's next generation market data environment to meet those needs. The incumbent serves as the authoritative technical expert and lead Data Scientist (Data Architect) for the enterprise-scale data architecture capable of being used by data science methods to support data science analysis of modern financial markets regulated by the CFTC. The incumbent provides expert-level market understanding and data science leadership across the CFTC's hybrid cloud data environment. This includes transaction processing systems built on Microsoft SQL Server 2019 hosted on Microsoft Azure and analytics systems operating on AWS, including Amazon Redshift, Amazon SageMaker, and ClickHouse. The incumbent serves as the foremost internal champion — or "evangelist" — for the next generation of data science techniques in the emerging market data environment across the CFTC enterprise. How would you like to become a part of a team providing compassionate care to Veterans? The VA has adopted Core Values and Characteristics that apply universally across the Department. The five Core Values define "who we are," our culture, and how we care for Veterans, their families and other beneficiaries. The Values are Integrity, Commitment, Advocacy, Respect and Excellence ("I CARE"). As a VA professional, your opportunities are endless. MajorDuties: Major Duties: Conduct advanced quantitative and qualitative analyses to identify healthcare improvement opportunities, evaluate innovative solutions, and validate findings using statistical methods, machine learning, natural language processing, computer vision, and predictive or prescriptive analytics. Extract, integrate, and analyze structured and unstructured clinical data from electronic health records and other sources, including wearable devices, sensors, diagnostic imaging, vital signs, and patient-generated data. Lead cross-functional teams in gathering requirements, assessing needs, establishing priorities, and developing roadmaps, testing plans, and deployment strategies for healthcare analytics solutions. Develop and implement analytics architecture, technical standards, and development methods addressing prototyping, code review, metadata, testing, change control, security, documentation, and software release. Maintain, manage, and configure complementary enterprise and developmental software systems that support data analytics, clinical and administrative workflows, collaboration, safety, quality, and organizational efficiency. Coordinate project resources and provide scientific, technical, and operational direction to interdisciplinary teams, including VA staff, academic researchers, private-sector collaborators, and other government partners. Develop and deliver training, instruction, and technical guidance on data interpretation and analytics systems; lead user adoption and change-management activities across the VHA data science community. Develop proof-of-concept analytics solutions and coordinate their implementation into clinical practice, including integration of clinical decision-support tools into electronic health records, in collaboration with appropriate technical, privacy, security, legal, and information technology partners. Evaluate project feasibility, implementation progress, and clinical or operational impact using key performance indicators, end-user feedback, and other performance measures; resolve technical and systems-performance problems and recommend improvements. Present findings, decision briefings, technical recommendations, and scientific manuscripts to executive leaders, stakeholders, and professional audiences; advise on emerging technologies and the development and expansion of effective healthcare analytics solutions Work Schedule: Monday - Friday, 8:00a.m. - 4:30p.m. PST Position Description Title/PD#: Data Scientist (Healthcare)~/03592A Physical Requirements: The work is primarily sedentary, although some physical effort may be required (e.g., walking, standing, carrying light items such as manuals or briefcases, or driving or traveling by motor vehicle). Incumbent must have the ability to work within an environment of conflicting deadlines and shifting priorities. Incumbent may be required to work evenings and weekends, as well as perform infrequent overnight travel to meetings and conferences.

We recommend saving and uploading your resume as a PDF to maintain formatting and number of pages. We also accept GIF, JPG, JPEG, PNG, RTF, TXT, PDF, ODT or Word (DOC or DOCX). We do not accept PDF portfolio files. We recommend using a sans-serif font size like Lato, if available. Other widely available options are Calibri, Helvetica, Arial, Verdana, Open San Source Sans Pro, Roboto or Noro Sans. Make your page margins 0.5 inches. Consider using 14-point size font for titles and 10-point for the main text in your resume. The resume builder can help you create a resume using these recommendations and uses the information in your USAJOBS profile to help you get started. Helpful Hints for Creating a Two-Page Resume: Prioritize most relevant and recent experience Use concise, results focused language Align language from the job announcement Focus on demonstrating skills and competencies Remove outdated or unrelated experience Use the USAJOBS resume builder Additional guidance on this new requirement and resume building tools can be found at: https://usajobshelp.opm.gov/hc/en-us/articles/52839989720851-How-do-I-write-a-resume-for-a-federal-job https://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/hiring-information/merit-hiring-plan-resources/applicant-guidance-on-the-two-page-resume-limit/ Special Employment Consideration: VA encourages persons with disabilities to apply, including those eligible for hiring under 5 CFR 213.3102(u), Schedule A, Appointment of persons with disabilities (i.e., intellectual disabilities, severe physical disabilities, or psychiatric disabilities), and/or disabled veterans with a compensable service-connected disability of 30% or more. For more information on how to apply using this appointment authority via the Selective Placement Coordinator within the office, contact the facility Human Resources Department at (414) 384-2000. The Interagency Career Transition Assistance Plan (ICTAP) and Career Transition Assistance Plan (CTAP) provide eligible displaced Federal competitive service employees with selection priority over other candidates for competitive service vacancies. To be qualified you must submit appropriate documentation and be found well-qualified (have a final rating of 85 or more before any Veterans preference points) for this vacancy. Information about ICTAP and CTAP eligibility is on OPM's Career Transition Resources website at http://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/workforce-restructuring/employee-guide-to-career-transition/.
Details.WhatToExpectNext: Once your online application is submitted you will receive a confirmation notification by email. After the vacancy announcement closes, we will review applications per Category Rating procedures to ensure qualification and eligibility requirements are met. If initial application submission is updated and resubmitted with a new resume, only the most current resume will be reviewed for consideration. After the review is complete, a referral certificate(s) is issued and applicants will be notified of their status by email. Referred applicants will be notified as such and may be contacted directly by the hiring office for an interview. All referred applicants receive a final notification once a selection decision has been made. You may check the status of your application at any time by logging into your USA Jobs account and clicking on Applications. Information regarding your application status can be found in the USAJobs Help Center. NOTE: Participation in the seasonal influenza program is a condition of employment and a requirement for all Department of Veterans Affairs Health Care Personnel (HCP). It is a requirement that all HCP to receive annual seasonal influenza vaccination or obtain an exemption for medical or religious reasons. Wearing a face mask is required when an exemption to the influenza vaccination has been granted. HCP in violation of this directive may face disciplinary action up to and including removal from federal service. HCP are individuals who, during the influenza season, work in VHA locations or who come into contact with VA patients or other HCP as part of their duties. VHA locations include, but are not limited to, VA hospitals and associated clinics, community living centers (CLCs), community-based outpatient clinics (CBOCs), domiciliary units, Vet centers and VA-leased medical facilities. HCP include all VA licensed and unlicensed, clinical and administrative, remote and onsite, paid and without compensation, full- and part-time employees, intermittent employees, fee basis employees, VA contractors, researchers, volunteers and health professions trainees (HPTs) who are expected to perform any or all of their work at these facilities. HPTs may be paid or unpaid and include residents, interns, fellows and students. HCP also includes VHA personnel providing home-based care to Veterans and drivers and other personnel whose duties put them in contact with patients outside VA medical facilities.
